# `jouet`

- **Usage:** `jouet [--json] [--display <MODE>] <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Global Flags
- **`--json`** — Print one JSON document instead of text
- **`--display <MODE>`** — Who the output is for: agent, human or plain. Detected when not given

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
- **`-V --version`** — Print version
